about: How the console writes prompts for new pictures. Every prompt ends with the DETAILS paragraph and then the style line of its part (use), in place of any other style line: the lessons' questions are realistic; the signs, right of way and rules keep the style of the app's road-sign pictures (a clean flat vector illustration). Change them here.
details: DETAILS (this picture is for a driving-theory app, so these must be exactly right, sharp and easy to read): every traffic sign in its exact official Danish design (shape, border, colours, symbol, numbers and any plate under it), at the described place and side; every road marking exactly as described (white or yellow, solid or broken, single or double lines, arrows and the way they point, stop lines, give-way triangles «shark teeth», zebra crossings, cycle-lane and bus-lane markings); traffic lights with exactly the described lamp lit; indicators and brake lights when they matter; vehicles, cyclists and pedestrians at the described positions, lanes and sides. Draw no signs, markings or lights that are not described. Right-hand traffic, as in Denmark.

styles.realistic: Style: realistic, modern, high-quality 3D render like a modern driving simulator, close to a photograph: natural light, true-to-life materials, sharp focus everywhere, 4:3. Signs and markings crisp and fully legible. No watermark, no logo, no brand names, no readable text except what is on the traffic signs, no recognisable real people.
styles.illustration: Style: a clean flat vector illustration for a Danish driving-theory app, the same style as the app's road-sign pictures, NOT photorealistic and NOT a 3D render: simple clean shapes, flat even colours, crisp edges, only very soft shadows, uncluttered, with plenty of space around the important part; where there is no scenery, a plain very light grey background (#f2f3f5). Road signs, road markings and traffic lights always in their official Danish design (shape, colours, symbols); right-hand traffic, as in Denmark. No watermark, no logo, no brand names, no readable text except what is on the traffic signs, no recognisable real people.
